tools.name: estimate_prepport_base_cost
tools.description: Estimate public USD starting costs. Inspection: sampleChecks; prep: units; standalone pick-pack: orders. Storage: cubicMeters and either storageDays or months (30 days each), plus alreadyStoredDays when the batch is not new. The same batch gets 90 free days, not a new grace period. Yanwen parcel rat

tools.description: Plan a first sourcing, inspection, prep, storage or fulfillment job. Return requirements, steps and a registration link. The channel identifies the seller platform; it does not connect it. No account, inquiry, order or store connection is created. Do not send contact details or private customer reco
